newsitem.title: USA: FAA seeks to suspend Fine Air pilots.
newsitem.headline: FAA seeks to suspend Fine Air pilots.

text.p: The Federal Aviation Administration is seeking to suspend the certificates of 29 pilots employed by Fine Air Services Inc, an FAA spokeswoman said.
"We've proposed to suspend the certificates of 29 of Fine Air's pilots," FAA spokeswoman Kathleen Bergen said.
Bergen said the action was not final and would follow due process procedures. Further details were not immediately available.
A Fine Air spokeswoman said the company had no information on the action.
One of the cargo carrier's DC-8-61F jets crashed on takeoff near Miami International Airport on Thursday, killing all four people aboard. The cause of the accident is not known.
